raw_text: A war gaming scenario from an online defence forum describing a hypothetical Chinese amphibious operation against India's Andaman Islands was mistakenly circulated as genuine intelligence on social media platforms this week. Defence analysts quickly traced the content to a clearly labelled fiction thread. Indian Navy officials declined to comment but sources indicated no change in the security posture at the Andaman and Nicobar Command.
clean_text: Defence News Asia reports war gaming scenario mistakenly circulated as genuine intelligence. Analysts traced to labelled fiction thread. Indian Navy reported no change in Andaman security posture.
